name: Synthetic CT Data Generation
definition: Generates synthetic CT training data by creating random elliptical phantoms, computing their sinograms, adding Poisson-like noise, and reconstructing via FBP to create input-target pairs.
summary: Synthetic CT Data Generation creates labeled training pairs by procedurally generating ground-truth phantoms, simulating their projection data, and reconstructing them, differing from voxel grid generation by focusing on the full forward-backward pipeline.
